summary: End-to-end testing of GiftXpert lead-gen site. 13/13 backend pytest tests passed and 13/13 Playwright UI flows passed. Categories (9), products (35), category/subcategory filters, product detail, enquiry creation (valid + validation errors), enquiry listing (newest first), no _id leakage, WhatsApp float, Request-a-Quote modal, Contact form, mobile menu all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses db.enquiries.insert_one({**doc}) then pops _id; find_one/find already project out _id so responses are clean, verified in tests.
seed_database() uses count_documents==0 guard; idempotent. Good.

frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to xpert-staging.preview.emergentagent.com rather than the eac8be59 host given in the review request; the app works fine with the configured URL, but main agent should confirm which domain is authoritative.
CONTACT info (phone, whatsapp number 917296976875) is hardcoded in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js - acceptable for a marketing site but consider moving to env if it needs to change per environment.
seed_data_creation: Backend self-seeds 9 categories and 35 products on startup (lifespan). Test enquiries created with 'TEST_' / automation prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL resolved from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://xpert-staging.preview.emergentagent.com). All required data-testid attributes exist for Header (header-request-quote-btn, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-nav-*), EnquiryDialog (enquiry-dialog, enquiry-input-*, enquiry-submit-btn, enquiry-success), Home (home-page, hero-section, categories-section, category-card-{slug}), Categories page (categories-page-card-{slug}), Category page (subcategory-card-{slug}, category-view-all-products, category-product-{slug}), Listing (filter-all, filter-{sub}, product-card-{slug}), Product detail (product-detail-page, product-main-image, thumb-{i}, product-enquire-btn, product-whatsapp-btn), About (about-stat-{i}, about-enquire-btn), Contact (contact-form, contact-*, contact-submit-btn, contact-success, contact-map), WhatsAppFloat (whatsapp-float-btn).
